qualifying_attempts.relay: single polling loop per connection, frozen, binary 7b1097f8
qualifying_attempts.conditions: three peer sessions confirmed quiet beforehand; no compiler or model process running; host load average about 4 from desktop applications
qualifying_attempts.verdict: FAIL 8/9. The 1 Gbit/s zero-delay point read 78.5 us low against its preceding baseline (tolerance 50 us) and 36.9 us low against its following baseline.
qualifying_attempts.mechanism: The zero-delay relay baseline is bimodal across relay instances: most of the 18 baselines in this run sit at 75-106 us, three sit at 118-130 us. The failing point's preceding baseline was one of the high ones (127.8 us). Relay self-reported lateness stayed at or below 5 us mean throughout, so the relay met its own schedule; the extra time is in the end-to-end path of some instances and its cause is not identified.
qualifying_attempts.consequence: Under the bounded-investigation rule a failed qualifying attempt stops the work: no second attempt, no sweep, no relay change.
